coordinates.global_axes: X forward, Y left, Z up
coordinates.board_local_axes: x along length, y across width, z from PCB bottom toward components
coordinates.kicad_assumption: Final native outline coordinates (0,0)..(80,32), checked by verify_hardware.py
coordinates.kicad_to_global: X=KiCad_x-50; Y=16-KiCad_y; Z=13+physical height above PCB bottom

board.mounting_hardware: 4 x M3x14 through screws, 4 x 5mm insulating unthreaded spacers, 8 x M3 washers OD7 ID3.2 thickness0.5, 4 x M3 nuts AF5.5 height2.4; 16 added metal items, not part of base 134 metal instances

host_tray.height_basis: Actual STEP support surfaces sampled at slot centre X and slot centre Y +/-2.5mm; tray support plate spans Z6..8.

fit_boundaries.pressure_hardware: Do not drill, enlarge ports, modify seals or assume undocumented thread equivalence
fit_boundaries.rear_ports: One M10 reserved for Bar02; eight M6 remain. Actual sensor thread/seat must match purchased rear-cap revision.
fit_boundaries.motor_reference: APISQUEEN X2 freshwater only; saltwater operation is not approved by this project
fit_boundaries.controller_fit_scope: Nominal native STEP/component models (including declared IMU/USB envelopes), GH plug/bend reservations and M3 mounting stack against unchanged tray, camera carrier, tube, front/rear fittings and camera. This is not physical fit or complete electrical packaging qualification.
